en: A monochrome postcard-style image showing a bustling market square in front of a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance building with domes and towers. Numerous stalls with umbrellas line the square, and people in early 20th‑century clothing walk and trade. On the left side a church tower rises above the surrounding buildings. Printed German text in the upper left identifies the scene as Graz and mentions the town hall, Herrengasse, and parish church.
